title: videoflow audio-structure sidecar
description: Schema for <stem>.chapters.json — the structural database for one media file. See videoflow/docs/architecture/audio-structure-primitive.md for design rationale, field categories, and merge semantics.

schema.description: Identifies this file shape. Optional in v2.x for back-compat with v1 sidecars; required by writers going forward.

version.description: Schema version. 2.x is the expanded shape (chapters + phrases + energy + provenance). 1.x is chapters-only.

auto_generated.description: Top-level marker. false indicates the file has been edited by a UI. Per-record auto_generated on each chapter / phrase is more precise and is what merge rules actually consult.

generated_by.description: Identifies the tool that originally produced the sidecar. Provenance entries record subsequent writes.

chapters.description: Ordered list of chapters covering the media's timeline.

phrases.description: Within-chapter intent units. Not required to be contiguous or to cover the whole chapter.

energy.description: Energy / beat / envelope analysis. Absent means not analyzed; consumers should run analysis if they need it.

provenance.description: Append-only audit log of writers. Oldest first.

end_ms.description: STRUCTURAL. Chapter end in milliseconds. null = until next chapter or end of media.

intent.description: AUTHORED. Chapter intent vocabulary (intro / build / sustain / edge / climax / recover / outro).

content_type.description: ANALYTICAL. Audio content-type heuristic from auto-detection.

evidence.description: ANALYTICAL. Feature ids that fired (mfcc / silence / rms_variance / recurrence_matrix / ...).

tone.description: MIXED. FunscriptForge mood label (closed enum). Authorial; forgegen does not assign.

shape.description: MIXED. forgegen curve-direction primitive. Drives the per-phrase center trajectory used by beats_to_curve. Distinct from `tone` (mood label). Forgegen's UI labels this control 'Tone' for end users; the schema field is `shape` to avoid colliding with FunscriptForge's mood `tone` in the data model.

include.description: AUTHORED. false = consumer skips this chapter (don't generate, don't include in assembly, don't render in nav).

auto_generated.description: LATCH. false = this record was authored / edited by a user; freeze ALL fields including ANALYTICAL on the next regen.

tone.description: MIXED. Optional override of chapter tone for this phrase.

percentiles.description: Whole-file percentiles of the normalised RMS envelope.

times_ms.description: Beat positions in milliseconds, monotonically increasing.

strengths.description: Beat strength in [0, 1]; same length as times_ms when present.

envelope.description: Sampled RMS envelope. May be inlined (sample_rate_hz + times_ms + values) or externalised ({external: true}); when external, the envelope lives in <stem>.energy.json.

per_chapter.description: Per-chapter analysis keyed by stringified chapter index.

writer.description: Module or app id (e.g. videoflow.structural, FunscriptForge, forgeassembler).

fields.description: Dotted paths or block names touched by this write (e.g. chapters[1].name, phrases, energy.beat_map).
